title: MAYDAY — critical distress
description: A simulated aircraft declares distress and needs urgent assistance.

title: PAN-PAN — urgency
description: An urgent but not yet distress-level event may escalate.

title: Squawk 7700 — general emergency
description: A general emergency indication is raised; cause remains a separate field.

title: Squawk 7500 — unlawful interference
description: A security-sensitive simulated event invokes a dedicated policy.

title: Squawk 7600 — radio failure
description: Communication loss is simulated with uncertainty and contingency assumptions.

title: Engine failure / technical malfunction
description: Aircraft performance assumptions change and candidate destinations are reevaluated.

title: Onboard medical emergency
description: Medical response time and feasible diversion options are considered.

title: Low fuel / fuel-system alert
description: Available endurance constrains feasible destination and route choices.

title: Presidential visit / VIP security zone
description: A temporary security zone conflicts with normal traffic and an unexpected emergency.

title: Sudden temporary flight restriction
description: A region closes while agents are in flight.

title: Military exercise airspace
description: A restricted military sector blocks otherwise attractive paths.

title: Airport closure
description: One airport is removed from the destination set.

title: Airspace corridor closure
description: A major graph corridor is blocked and affected paths are recomputed.

title: Drone incursion near airport
description: A localized synthetic hazard affects nearby traffic.

title: Security restriction changes mid-flight
description: The restricted geometry changes while routes are active.

title: Severe crosswind
description: Runway feasibility is evaluated against configured aircraft limits.

title: Gusting wind
description: Gust inputs change and runway feasibility is recalculated.

title: Moving thunderstorm
description: A time-varying weather hazard moves across the graph.

title: Heavy rain / reduced visibility
description: Configurable visibility constraints change feasible options.

title: Fog / low visibility
description: Landing options are reevaluated under simulated visibility limits.

title: Windshear alert
description: A synthetic alert marks an approach area as unavailable for the scenario.

title: Weather deteriorates during reroute
description: A route becomes invalid after conditions change.

title: Weather feed unavailable
description: Weather uncertainty is explicitly surfaced instead of assuming safe conditions.

title: Sudden runway closure
description: A runway is marked unavailable during the simulation.

title: Aircraft-specific runway compatibility
description: Runway candidates are filtered by configurable length and compatibility.

title: Heterogeneous aircraft performance
description: Heavy, narrowbody, regional and turboprop profiles have different constraints.

title: Runway congestion
description: Several arrivals compete for limited runway occupancy windows.

title: Limited runway capacity
description: Landing slots are constrained and must be scheduled.

title: Required emergency services unavailable
description: Relevant destinations are filtered or flagged when modeled support is unavailable.

title: Diversion airport at capacity
description: An alternate airport cannot accept unlimited redirected traffic.

title: Taxiway / ground movement disruption
description: A post-landing ground constraint is included in scenario outcomes.

title: Two aircraft converge on same cell
description: Space-time occupancy conflicts are detected and resolved where possible.

title: Multiple emergency landing requests
description: Several urgent agents compete for limited capacity.

title: Emergency versus VIP restriction
description: Emergency and security constraints are evaluated together.

title: Emergency diverts regional traffic
description: A destination disruption causes neighboring airports to absorb traffic.

title: Aircraft compete for same runway
description: Runway occupancy and arrival sequencing are modeled.

title: Reroute creates a new conflict
description: A changed route is checked against other agents' reservations.

title: Several emergencies simultaneously
description: Different event types are active in one compound simulation.

title: No feasible conflict-free plan
description: The planner should report infeasibility rather than invent a safe route.

title: PAN-PAN escalates to MAYDAY
description: An event state changes and triggers reprioritization and replanning.

title: Second emergency mid-reroute
description: A new event invalidates part of the current solution.

title: Delayed aircraft position update
description: Stale observations are identified and flagged.

title: Missing callsign or identity
description: Incomplete data is handled without inventing identity.

title: Position uncertainty increases
description: Aircraft position is represented by an uncertainty region.

title: Flight API unavailable
description: The last snapshot is retained with a stale-data warning.

effects.data_status: STALE - flight API unavailable, last snapshot retained

title: Mismatched data timestamps
description: Flight and weather data freshness is tracked independently.

effects.data_status: MISMATCHED - flight and weather timestamps differ

title: Route oscillation
description: Repeated route changes are monitored and damped in the prototype.

title: Emergency resolves / is cancelled
description: An active event clears and routes can be recomputed.

title: No feasible destination
description: The simulator reports that no candidate satisfies current modeled constraints.

title: Flagship: VIP restriction + MAYDAY
description: A distress event occurs during a security restriction with normal traffic present.

title: Flagship: MAYDAY + medical + gusts
description: Multiple urgent cases and weather constraints compete for landing options.

title: Flagship: multiple emergencies + runway closure
description: Limited runway availability intersects multiple urgent requests.

title: Flagship: moving storm + cascading diversions
description: A moving hazard redirects traffic and triggers a second event.

title: Flagship: full-system stress test
description: A compound scenario combines restrictions, emergencies, weather, runway and data issues.
